The review passes: every numbered ask in the brief is met, and the clipped text box on [/framework/ext/Refine/](/framework/ext/Refine/) is fixed (the 400 px shot shows its placeholder wrapping in full instead of being cut off).

⚠️ Two caveats:
- **The vanished "Can you hear me?" sentence is explained but not fixed.** The audit says the fix needs a live-mic test first, and that fix is the last step of the redesign proposal.
- **Two process steps can't be checked.** The progress cards on `/live/` and the five-line message to the voice mastermind leave nothing in the change, so I couldn't confirm either one.

The [Cleaner page](/framework/ext/Refine/cleaner/) leaves most of a wide screen empty (70% at 1920, 81% at 3440). That's a small thing, so it's a note, not a fix. The full report is `refine-audit/review/report.md`.
